countryroads.stake.surveying: Surveying a path to the nearest road...
countryroads.stake.preview: Path to the road: %s blocks (%s through rock). It costs nothing: right-click the stake (or the door or gate again) to build it, break the stake to cancel.
countryroads.path.built_hint: Path built. Sneak + right-click keeps it for good. To undo: left-click the door with the stake, or break the stake.
countryroads.path.committed: The path is part of the land now.
countryroads.path.nodrop: Path blocks crumble when broken: the path is free, so its steps, bridges and lanterns drop nothing.
countryroads.stake.no_bridge: No good place for a bridge on the way to the road. Put a stake on each bank, straight across the water, to show the path where to cross.
countryroads.stake.waypoint: Waypoint %s set: the path will pass here, in the order you place them (the dots over a stake count its number). Right-click a stake to build, break a waypoint to remove it. (Sneak while placing a stake to start a separate path.)
countryroads.stake.built: This path is built. Break the stake to take it up again.
countryroads.stake.no_road: No road within %s blocks. Place the stake closer to a road (it must be loaded).
countryroads.stake.on_road: The stake is already on the road.
